args.ui:title: List of pillar keys
args.ui:description: Return one or more pillars with values replaced by type indicators, e.g., 'secret password' → '<str>', ['secret', 1] → ['<str>', '<int>'], {'login': 'somelogin', 'pwd': 'secret'} → {'login': '<str>', 'pwd': '<str>'}

pillar.ui:title: Pillar
pillar.ui:description: If specified, allows for a dictionary of pillar data to be made available to pillar and ext_pillar rendering. These pillar variables will also override any variables of the same name in pillar or ext_pillar
